summary: BIP Ventures Evergreen BDC filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting a routine quarterly cash distribution of $0.0162 per share declared by its board on June 29, 2026, payable July 15, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026, totaling ~$79,656. This is a standard pass-through dividend from a BDC, not a special-situation event. No merger, tender, activist, spin-off, going-private, restructuring, or strategic review is mentioned. The filing is purely an other-events disclosure of a regular distribution. No deal terms or special structural mechanics are present.
